acceptance_criteria.criterion: Navigating to #/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid renders the workspace header (ID, description, project breadcrumb) and a repository status table with one row per repository.

Each repository row displays the current branch name, a color-coded Git status badge (showing modifiedFiles, localCommits ahead, unfetchedCommits behind, lastActivity, hasConflicts), and handles null status gracefully with a 'No data' or loading indicator.
The status table auto-refreshes via setInterval calling GET /api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid/status and updates badges in-place without re-rendering the entire view.
The polling interval is cleared when navigating away from the workspace detail view (verified by no leaked intervals after navigation).

Rename and Delete actions are disabled (visually and functionally) for the STABLE workspace and functional with confirmation dialogs for other workspaces (rename calls PUT .../rename with { newId }, delete calls DELETE .../workspaces/:wid).
